fieldDefinitions.nsrNo: National Specialist Register number (table column `NSR No`).
fieldDefinitions.title: Courtesy / professional title from NSR (e.g. DR).
fieldDefinitions.name: Specialist display name (plain text from the name cell link).
fieldDefinitions.gender: Gender string from NSR (e.g. Male, Female).
fieldDefinitions.establishmentRaw:
Workplace line(s) as returned by NSR, including leading `-` and ` ` decoded to spaces; may contain `
` for multiple sites.
fieldDefinitions.establishmentText: Same as establishmentRaw with HTML tags stripped and whitespace collapsed.
fieldDefinitions.specialtyColumn1: First `<td>` under the table header `Specialty` (colspan=2). Often the parent specialty (e.g. INTERNAL MEDICINE); may be empty when the only text is in column 2.
fieldDefinitions.specialtyColumn2: Second specialty `<td>` (e.g. subspecialty CARDIOLOGY, or sole specialty such as NEUROLOGY when column 1 is empty).
fieldDefinitions.specialtyDisplay: Human-readable join: non-empty column1 and column2 joined with ` | ` (same order as the site).
fieldDefinitions.detailRelativeUrl: Relative `list1viewdetails.asp?...` URL from the name or action link (first match in row).
fieldDefinitions.detailAbsoluteUrl: Absolute URL for the specialist detail page.
fieldDefinitions.accountId: Value of the `Account` query parameter on the detail link (NSR internal id; format varies, e.g. N-0-100196 or numeric).
fieldDefinitions.listPage: Result list page number this row was taken from (1-based).

notes: Each list row is one specialist registration line as shown on NSR; one person may appear more than once if registered at multiple establishments.
Specialty uses two table cells under one header; interpret specialtyColumn1 vs specialtyColumn2 together (see specialtyDisplay).
This file is a snapshot; counts and rows change when NSR updates their database.
